title: Isotonic Quantile Regression Averaging for uncertainty quantification of electricity price forecasts
abstract: arXiv:2507.15079v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Quantifying the uncertainty of forecasting models is essential to assess and mitigate the risks associated with data-driven decisions, especially in volatile domains such as electricity markets. In this paper, we propose a computationally efficient isotonic variant of Quantile Regression Averaging (QRA), called Isotonic Quantile Regression Averaging (iQRA), for generating probabilistic forecasts from ensembles of point forecasts. Building on QRA, we introduce stochastic order constraints as a hyperparameter-free regularization mechanism that reduces computational complexity while maintaining competitive forecast accuracy. We further demonstrate that the same isotonic regularization principle can be applied to the smoothed estimator of QRA. translated_title: 用于电价预测不确定性量化的保序分位数回归平均
translated_abstract: 量化预测模型的不确定性对于评估和降低与数据驱动决策相关的风险至关重要，尤其是在电力市场这类波动性较强的领域。本文提出了一种计算高效的分位数回归平均（QRA）的保序变体，称为保序分位数回归平均，用于从点预测的集成中生成概率预测。在QRA的基础上，我们引入随机序约束作为一种无需超参数的正则化机制，在保持具有竞争力的预测精度的同时降低了计算复杂度。我们进一步证明，同样的保序正则化原理也可以应用于QRA的平滑估计器。在对两个欧洲日前电力市场开展的大规模预测研究中，我们表明iQRA及其平滑变体始终位居最先进的后处理方法前列。
tldr: 本文提出了一种计算高效的保序分位数回归平均方法，通过引入无需超参数的随机序约束正则化机制，从点预测集成中生成准确且高效的概率电价预测。
